d:
The Karthigai Deepam dispute at Thiruparankundram Hill in Madurai has put two successive Tamil Nadu governments - the DMK under M K Stalin and the TVK under Vijay - in the spotlight over the implementation of court orders.
The dispute centres on the demand to light an additional festival lamp at Deepathoon, a stone pillar near the Sikkandar Badusha Dargah. This year, the Supreme Court permitted a one-time lighting on November 24, but the order was not implemented by the TVK government in Tamil Nadu.
